recommendation: Implement medication management strategies for housing-insecure patients
implementation_steps: Implement medication management strategies for transient patients
Provide extended medication supplies when appropriate
Coordinate with shelter-based medication storage programs
Use blister packs or other adherence aids for patients with unstable housing
Develop protocols for medication refills that accommodate address changes
evidence_summary: Pharmacist-led medication management interventions tailored for housing-insecure populations have demonstrated improvements in medication adherence and continuity of therapy for patients with unstable housing.
